title: Ines and the Asset
author: Edmund Nakamura
blurb: Emrys Thornbury, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
